name: Bhagyashri

story.x: Every road looks lovelier when it ends with you.
A flower in your hair, a laugh in the wind. I would notice you in any crowd.
No grand plan needed. Your hand in mine, and the rest figures itself out.
If life asked me to pick all over again, I would bow my head and pick you.
Even an ordinary room feels like a ball when you are in it.
Whatever comes next, I want to walk into it with you.

reasons: Your smile fixes my worst days.
You are patient with me when I do not deserve it.
You are stronger than you ever give yourself credit for.
Your laugh is my favourite sound.
You care for everyone before yourself.
Your eyes say what words cannot.
Bhagyashri means good fortune, and you are mine.
wish: Wish received. It is in the water now, and I will spend the whole year helping it come true.
letter: Every year on this day I stop and think about how lucky I am. Your name means good fortune, and you turned out to be mine in the truest way.
I know I do not say it enough, so I am writing it down where nobody can interrupt me: thank you.
Thank you for your patience on the days I was difficult, and for your smile on the days I did not deserve one.
Thank you for the small things nobody sees: the care, the quiet effort, the way you hold everything together and still make it look easy.
You make a house feel like a home, and an ordinary day feel like something worth remembering.
I am not perfect, and I will probably annoy you again tomorrow. But I promise to keep choosing you every single day, loudly and quietly, in the good times and the hard ones.
May this year give you everything you have been quietly hoping for: peace in your heart, laughter that reaches your eyes, and all the kindness you give so freely to others, coming back to you.
Whatever comes, you will never walk alone. I will be right beside you, holding your hand.
gift: Your real gift is waiting for you. Come and find Ram.

coupons.d: Place, food, plan. You decide, I show up.
On me. Just say the word.
